text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Unusual auth probe detected. 1200 failed /v1/auth/validate requests/min from 52.14.120.33 across multiple regions. Possible credential replay. Severity: P1. Paging oncall.
jamie: ACK, oncall here. collecting traces and live request samples. tagging security.
sara: I see repeated token prefixes that look like service-account tokens (svc-). pulling token issuance/time windows.
ops-bot: Temporary WAF rule applied to block 52.14.120.33 (ttl 1h) :shield: — will lift if false positive.
jamie: Good. Can someone check KV cache access logs and edge proxies for mirrored headers? worried about lateral replay.
sara: On it. quick grep across edge logs shows repeated Authorization header pattern: "Bearer svc_XYZ..." coming from at least 6 distinct IPs but same token prefix.
mike: Preparing bulk service-account key rotation plan. Will rotate keys for svc-* created before 2026-02-01 and revoke associated JWTs. ETA to start: 15:30 UTC.
jamie: Runbook note: rotate creds -> revoke active sessions -> monitor 1h -> escalate to customers if failures. I'll coordinate with CS for customer impact comms.
cs-lead: Heads up for customer comms: prepare a status note template. Likely small number of customers may see 401s during rotation window.
sara: Quick risk assessment: no S3 or DB write events from those token IDs in the last 24h. No obvious exfil. Still verifying if any logs contained plaintext tokens.
jamie: Searching for inadvertent log leaks. command I'm running: ```
# find uploads with auth token patterns
aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-logs --query 'Contents[].Key' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/{} - | grep -E "(svc_[A-Za-z0-9]{6,})|Authorization: Bearer"
```
ops-bot: Started tail on auth-nginx (region-1) and added extra sampling to capture full headers for 30m.
mike: Rotation script staged on infra-runbook. Will execute in small batches to avoid mass invalidation. batch size 50 svc-keys every 5 minutes.
liz: I will take over the live incident in 20m for next-oncall. jamie, please handoff once rotation starts.
jamie: Handoff plan: mike begins batch rotation at 15:30, ops-bot will maintain WAF rules and increase sampling, sara monitors for tokens and signs of exfil, cs-lead drafts customer note. liz you get escalation privileges and contact list.
cs-lead: Customer note draft: "We detected suspicious authentication attempts impacting a small subset of sessions. We are rotating affected service credentials and you may see brief 401s. No customer data has been identified as accessed. We will follow up with any customer-specific actions." feedback welcome.
sara: One more: found 3 log uploads from a staging pipeline that include base64 blobs matching token pattern. I'm quarantining those objects and flagging to infra to scrub and reingest without tokens.
mike: Confirmed. I'll revoke keys tied to those tokens immediately and kick rotation for related svc accounts.
jamie: Thanks. tagging legal if needed. incident-bot, mark ongoing. handing to liz in 10m. :white_check_mark: 
liz: taking over. monitoring dashboards + oncall bridge. postmortem owner noted (sara). final status update after rotation completes.
incident-bot: Incident status set to active. snooze: 30m.
